nodes.rationale: Centralized event discovery for IIT Delhi: students otherwise track ~39 club Instagram accounts manually.

nodes.label: Two-subsystem monorepo (app + scraper)
nodes.rationale: Frontend and ingestion are decoupled; Firestore is the only contract between them.

nodes.label: Instagram → Gemini → Firestore ingestion pipeline
nodes.rationale: Flyers are images, so OCR/vision extraction is required to obtain structured event fields.

nodes.label: Scheduled autonomous scraper (every 6h)
nodes.rationale: GitHub Actions cron avoids running any always-on server.

nodes.label: Crimson & Onyx design system
nodes.rationale: Strict theme tokens instead of ad-hoc styles keeps mobile and web visually identical.

nodes.label: IIT Delhi club & board Instagram directory
nodes.rationale: Canonical seed list of scrape targets, grouped by Boards / Clubs / Fests / Admin / Technical.

nodes.label: insta_ids duplicate (skills/)
nodes.rationale: Second, drifted copy of the handle directory (41 handles vs 45 in docs/; @enactus_iitd vs @enactus_iitdelhi).

nodes.label: TARGET_HANDLES scrape list
nodes.rationale: Hardcoded 27-handle subset curated by hand from the 45-entry docs directory.

nodes.label: Gemini flyer→structured-event extraction
nodes.rationale: responseSchema + temperature 0.0 forces deterministic JSON with a confidenceScore for downstream triage.

nodes.label: Event confidenceScore triage
nodes.rationale: Low-confidence extractions are queued for human curation rather than published blindly.

nodes.label: Firestore events collection (system contract)
nodes.rationale: Only integration point between the Python/Node scraper and the Expo client.

nodes.label: Client-side Gemini concierge calls
nodes.rationale: No backend server exists, so the app calls the Gemini REST API directly with an EXPO_PUBLIC_ key and a three-model fallback chain.

nodes.label: Local-first student identity (AsyncStorage)
nodes.rationale: Kerberos ID profile is stored on-device only; no Firebase Auth, so it is claimed, not verified.
